verdict.rationale: The flow-building docs say actions can include "running code," so the product itself offers a code step inside a workflow. That is a single passing mention. It does not say which languages are supported or how a code step works. The TypeScript piece-building docs cover authoring custom integrations, which is a different capability, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented JavaScript and/or Python code-step support, details of the code-step editor and runtime (packages, inputs/outputs, sandboxing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow

citations.quote: Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated, like running code or communicating with other services.
